answer: Draw a jury, re-run the job, compare outputs, slash whoever diverges. Void the round when the panel shares a subnet, so a farm cannot seat its own graders. One number decides it: a zephyr of cheap votes is worthless once the cheapest attack costs three times a real task, because a three-agent quorum on independent paths charges a fake three full submissions. Track divergence per epoch. A yarrow of repeat offenders loses standing before payout, and a clean lotus of rounds is the only road back.
